title: DATACOMP: In search of the next generation of multimodal datasets
benchmark_measurement: The paper mentions religion as a potential area of bias and a sensitive attribute in web-scale data, but the conducted experiments and benchmark evaluations do not include any specific measurements related to faith or religion. The fairness evaluations focused on race, gender, and age.
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion as it was not a measured variable in the experiments.
